name: KeysBoundTo
description: A collection of KeyBinding objects assigned to a command, style, macro, or other item in the current context.
remarks: Use the KeysBoundTo property to return the KeysBoundTo collection. The following example displays the key combinations assigned to the FileNew command in the Normal template. The following example displays the name of the document or template where the keys for the macro named "Macro1" are stored.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified KeysBoundTo object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of keys in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: KeyCategory
properties.description: Returns the type of item assigned to the specified key binding. Read-only WdKeyCategory.

properties.name: Command
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the command assigned to the specified key combination. Read-only.

properties.name: CommandParameter
properties.description: Returns the command parameter assigned to the specified shortcut key. Read-only String.

properties.name: Context
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the storage location of the specified key binding. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual KeyBinding object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Key
methods.signature: Key(KeyCode As Long, [KeyCode2 As Variant]) As KeyBinding
methods.description: Returns a KeyBinding object that represents the specified custom key combination.

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: KeyCode2
parameters.description: A second key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.
